rows.en: Lyle: "This is where we first fought...
And now we're going to fight here again.
Rayblade... Lenis... This time, we settle this!"
Touya: "I knew it was you, you bastard!!"
Lyle: "There's only one thing I want...
To take your life and that woman's!!"
Touya: "That woman...? You... Don't tell me you mean Ymir too..."
Lyle: "You seduced Wenimas, and even had a child with her...
I'll never forgive you for that...
I'll wipe anyone who does that off the face of this world..."
Ai: "...Are you an idiot?
What the hell would that accomplish?!"
Lyle: "My... My heart died that day...
Now I'm just a pathetic loser
driven by nothing but revenge...
Hehehehe... Don't ask someone like that to explain himself.
Whatever's driving me is telling me to do this..."
Touya: "Wait a minute! Wenimas..."
Lyle: "Don't you dare speak her name so casually!
Don't worry. I'll slaughter you first..."
Ai: "Touya, there's no point trying to talk to him..."
Fain: "Fine by me! I, Fain Jin Barion,
will settle this right here! Brace yourself!"
Lyle: "Shut up, small fry..."
Fain: "W-w-w-what did you say?!!"
Lyle: "You lot can play with this!"
Lyle: "...Now, let's begin."
Mysterious Figure: "I'll lend you a hand too."
Touya: "Huh? What's that mech?
I feel like I've seen it somewhere..."
Melissa: "That's Bine Daga... Dr. Baio?"
Mysterious Figure: "I know no one by the name of Baio.
You've got entirely the wrong person, young lady."
Melissa: "I can tell it's you even with your voice disguised.
Why are you hiding your identity?"
Mysterious Figure: "I told you, I don't know anyone named Baio,
Melissa... I-I mean, young lady."
Melissa: "Then it is you, Doctor."
Mysterious Figure: "I told you it isn't!
Anyway, I'm here to help!!
Watch closely and see how strong I am!"
Touya: "Hey! Listen to me!"
Lyle: "Shut up! This is my only chance!
Debish won't let me kill you...
That's why it has to be now!"
Touya: "You..."
Lyle: "A real fight, with our lives on the line. Thrilling, isn't it?
Let's settle this, Touya!"
Touya: "Wait! Wenimas never betrayed you..."
Lyle: "Enough talk!"
Touya: "Tch! You stubborn bastard!"
Leone: "Lyle! Stop it already!
This isn't going to accomplish anything!"
Lyle: "Hmph... A defective doll, acting so high and mighty..."
Leone: "Why do you always talk to me like that?!
Lyle: "That's why you're such an idiot.
Haven't you figured it out yet?
You're a doll Bernst made!"
Touya: "?!"
Yamato: "Leone was... made...?"
Leone: "What... are you saying...?
Y-you're making fun of me..."
Lyle: "You're an expendable doll made for experiments
with the Ze=Ode Spirit Mechs. Believe it or not, I don't care."
Leone: "That's a lie! It's a lie! You're lying!!"
Lyle: "Think about it. It's obvious.
Have you ever had a meal with the doctor or Sharl?
What about your birthday? Have they ever said a single word to celebrate it?"
Leone: "..."
Lyle: "I've got nothing against you.
Stand down quietly, or else... I'll take you down!"
Leone: "I..."
Touya: "Leone! What are you doing?!"
Leone: "Touya... I..."
Touya: "Get a grip! I don't care who you are!
You're one of us! Isn't that enough for you?"
Leone: "One of you..."
Touya: "That's right. Besides, you're the only one
who can define your own existence. You feel pain. You laugh...
How are you any different from us?
What kind of being are you? That doesn't matter.
What do you think of yourself? What do you want to be?
That's what matters. Believe in yourself.
Whoever you are, whatever you are, we're on your side."
Leone: "Touya... Thank you...
A-all right! I won't worry about any of that anymore!
I'll believe in myself, in everyone... and in you, Touya!"
Lyle: "...Believe, huh...? Heh."
Mysterious Figure: "What?! That field really is the problem.
Even Bine Daga can only do this much...
No choice, then. Those small fry..."
Mysterious Figure: "...I'll dispose of them!"
Mysterious Figure: "...Wait, there aren't any!
Mmmmm... I'll leave the rest to you!"
Lyle: "..."
Touya: "...What was that all about?"
Touya: "Hah... Hah... Is it... over?"
Yamato: "After that, the pilot inside must be..."
Touya: "You idiot... Wenimas...
She never betrayed you..."
Mysterious Figure: "Hmm. It seems you've finished up.
Well then, I'll be on my way!
Until we meet again! Wahahahahaha!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Touya, hey."
Touya: "O-oh... Yeah..."

review_batches.context: All 107 rows read. Lyle seeks a decisive rematch at the Holy Land, repeats his jealous Wenimas accusation, refuses Touya's correction, and exposes Leone's manufactured origin. Mysterious Figure in Bine Daga denies being Baio despite Melissa recognizing him. Touya reassures Leone.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Lyle's false betrayal/parentage belief as his accusation, not narrator fact. Do not add Lenis parentage to the translation or correct Lyle mid-speech. Doll/expendable are his dehumanizing words, not evidence of mechanical anatomy; no real creation procedure added. Preserve named versus hidden labels, Baio/Bio distinction, singular aid direction, lethal threats, meal/birthday questions and Touya's identity affirmation. Source deliberately interrupted/fragmentary reactions are noted below. Row boundary between 79/80 remains a continuing open quote.

row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o0056d.l00: This refers to the opposition Lyle brings out; no count or unspoken mech name supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00695.l00: Aid is to Touya's side; the source still labels the speaker Mysterious Figure.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o006b2.l01: Restore Touya as the person who finds the mech familiar.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o006dd.l00: Recognition/address fragment retained. The named engineer is Baio, not the distinct arms dealer Bio.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00784.l01: He accidentally uses Melissa's name, then corrects himself; preserve self-exposure and stammer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o008b8.l00: Now is his only chance because Debish forbids killing Touya; do not invent a physical countdown.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o0095b.l00: Touya begins correcting the false betrayal belief and is cut off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00a0e.l00: Defective doll is Lyle's insult, not a new canonical species or diagnosis.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00a38.l01: Leone's I is deliberately interrupted/unfinished; likewise 72 and 74.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00aab.l00: Punctuation-only startled reaction retained in English order.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00abb.l00: Yamato echoes the shock as a deliberately broken question, not a claim about the manufacturing method.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00add.l01: Restore Lyle as the one she says is mocking her.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00b0e.l00: Doll/expendable refer to Lyle's preceding accusation; no android anatomy or experimental procedure is added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00b79.l02: Two specific tests of family treatment: birthday and any spoken celebration. Do not infer a missing date or a literal inability to eat.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00cb9.l00: Leone echoes Touya's one-of-us phrase as a fragment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_02a.o00cd0.l01: Define renders recognition/understanding of one's own existence in Touya's reassurance, not authority to rewrite biological facts.

review_batches.context: End of the same fully read member. Touya completes his reassurance, Leone resolves to trust the team; the mysterious helper struggles against the field and finds no small fry left. After battle Yamato trails off about the pilot's fate while Touya laments Lyle's misunderstanding.
review_batches.decisions: Do not turn the implied pilot fate into an explicit medical confirmation or survival guarantee. The field is not explicitly named Sorge here; preserve generic wording. Keep helper's small-fry target and comic discovery across row split without inventing an enemy count. Maintain open quote inherited from row 78 and the original silences, stammers, unfinished lament and address-only reactions.
